source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi BhaveshKumar,

I want to make sure you understand before awarding you the project.

A few points:

Dont worry about the print version of the magazine. Lets just make sure the digital magazine flip book version is done by July 27 or so.

\-Ensure the layout is polished and modern. And must match the branding of <http://WBEdition.com|WBEdition.com>
\-Gather articles directly from the website.
\-Use AI to enhance image quality if needed.
\-Include the author’s name and a small circular author photo for every article.
\-If more images are needed for the magazine format, the designer must request them.
\-The best method of collaboration is via MS Teams.
\-The digital magazine must launch one week before August 1st, which means July 25th.

Let me know if all is clear.

Thanks,

Whilly

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi B,

Thanks for your efforts. There is no need for a print version unless someone asks for prints.

But if the Flip Book can be up and live by 6am Eastern Time that would be great. Otherwise, Friday is terrible for a launch. Thanks

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Very disappointing.. This is the only time we had to launch. Later is too late and on Friday you cant send out a communication.

So its safe to say that we cannot launch an August 1st inaugural issue because that's on a Saturday. So  everything will have to be changed for September, not good.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the available launch window was missed and that a later launch would be too late for the August issue.
